create.name: Grandmother Flordemayo
create.bio:
Grandmother Flordemayo is a Mayan elder and curandera espiritu, a healer of divine spirit. Born in the highlands of Nicaragua, the youngest of fifteen children, she was raised by her mother, a midwife, in a family of traditional healers. For decades she has travelled to offer ceremony and prayer and to speak on subjects from herbal tradition to the spiritual care of seeds. She was a founding member of the International Council of Thirteen Indigenous Grandmothers and of several other Indigenous elder and knowledge councils.

In 2012 she founded The Path, a non-profit in Estancia, New Mexico, whose Seed Temple conserves heirloom and heritage seeds and prepares prayer-blessed seed bundles for future generations. Her teaching centres on prayer as daily practice, Mayan cosmology and the sacred calendar, ancestral connection, and ceremonies of fire, water, earth and wind drawn from the curanderismo tradition. She shares this through ceremonies and gatherings, short prayers and talks on her YouTube channel, and a series of self-paced courses with The Shift Network.

courses.title: Curanderismo & Mayan Elemental Healing
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course in ceremonial practice from the Mayan and curanderismo traditions. It works with prayer, breath, fire, water, earth and weaving, including a whispered prayer, a wind bundle, a water blessing and a daily ritual wheel.

courses.title: Grandmother's Healing Circle
courses.description: A thirteen-module self-paced course on prayer, energy clearing, forgiveness and Mayan ceremony, including fire and water ceremonies, the despacho prayer bundle and labyrinth walking. It focuses on connecting with Mother Earth, the ancestors and your own spiritual path.

courses.title: Mayan & Curanderismo Rituals to Heal, Awaken & Uplift Yourself & the Heart of the World
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module introduction to curanderismo through ceremony, prayer and ritual. Practices include a limpia cleansing, building an altar, moon water and dream work.

courses.title: Connect to Your Ancestors Through Mayan Cosmology
courses.description: A thirteen-module self-paced course on drawing on ancestral wisdom through Mayan cosmology and the Mayan Tree of Life. It covers maternal and paternal lineage, a sacred fire ceremony, a humming prayer and building a daily spiritual practice.

courses.title: Power of Prayer
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand course on prayer as a daily practice, from surrender and setting intentions to praying for others. It also introduces elemental rituals such as fire ceremony, the medicine wheel and ceremonies for the solstices and equinoxes.

courses.title: Grandmother's Wisdom Circle
courses.description: A seven-session on-demand audio course in which Grandmother Flordemayo teaches prayer, humming, forgiveness and Mayan cosmology as ways of living everyday life as sacred.

courses.title: Universal Wisdom From the Mayan Calendar
courses.description: A seven-session on-demand audio course on the daily symbols and energies of the Mayan calendar. It teaches ritual, prayer, meditation and altar-making as ways to align daily life with each day's sacred meaning.

flags: The published email (hhalldudney@gmail.com) belongs to her daughter and assistant Heather, given on the Private Healing Sessions page for session bookings; her site also has a general contact form.
Her site says she is on a health sabbatical caring for her husband; private sessions are currently given by her daughter, so she may be slow to respond.
Her standing as a founding member of the International Council of Thirteen Indigenous Grandmothers is greater than her ~50k follower count suggests.
'Connect to Your Ancestors Through Mayan Cosmology': the Shift page shows unfilled price placeholders, so price is set to 'Contact for pricing'.

Several course titles use 'heal' in a spiritual sense (Healing Circle, Elemental Healing, Rituals to Heal); no conditions are named in their titles or main descriptions, so they were kept. Module lists mention ancestral trauma and grief.
YouTube avatar carries a small photographer watermark in the corner.
left_out: Private healing sessions ($255 suggested donation): currently given by her daughter, not her, and one-to-one is not her main way of working.
Mayan Prayer Circle for the New Year (Shift 'Sacred Dawn'): an old dated live event.
Website webinars (2020, e.g. Crystal Skull Wisdom, Trauma and Healing I) and 2017 video archives: dated, and one condition-named.
2021 Spiritual Workbook/Planner: dated print run, sold on her site only, no Amazon listing.
Love and Light LLC offerings: run by her daughter Heather.

Videos: promotional invitations and clips under ~2 minutes (Guardians of the Sacred trailers, Giving Season, Temple of the Golden Child 2:01), the conversation with Stephen Dinan (Shift founder, shared), Grandmother Devi Tide and LeeAnn Hill videos (other speakers), and long event recordings with other speakers (Sacred Reciprocity Gathering, Guardians community circle, A Prayer for Chaco).
